extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the analysis: (1) 'dream' in the 'island' column was lowercase and needed normalization to 'Dream'; (2) 'male' in the 'sex' column had whitespace variants that were normalized to 'male'; (3) three rows had invalid values: one with a negative flipper length (-195 mm), and two with extremely high body mass (4,000,000 g and 5,400,000 g), all of which were excluded as they violated the data rules. After fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins was calculated as 39.39 mm on Biscoe, 39.27 mm on Dream, and 37.53 mm on Torgersen.
